PACK_TAG_FILTER_ROW:

Click to cycle: off → OR (✓) → AND (O) → NOT (✕).
OR rows combine with OR; every O row must match together; NOT rows hide matches first.
PACK_TAG_FILTER_NONE:

AND (O): require empty pack tags together with other O rows.
NOT (✕): hide cards with no pack tags.

STAT_FILTER_PACK_WEIGHT_MIN:
Minimum PackWeight

Only show cards whose PackWeightMultiplier is at least this value (YgoDuelist cards; others count as 1). Leave empty for no lower bound.
STAT_FILTER_PACK_WEIGHT_MAX:
Maximum PackWeight

Only show cards whose PackWeightMultiplier is at most this value (YgoDuelist cards; others count as 1). Leave empty for no upper bound.
STAT_FILTER_ATK_MIN:
Minimum ATK

Only show YgoDuelist monsters whose printed ATK is at least this value. Leave empty for no lower bound. Spells, traps, and non-monster cards are not affected.
STAT_FILTER_ATK_MAX:
Maximum ATK

Only show YgoDuelist monsters whose printed ATK is at most this value. Leave empty for no upper bound. Spells, traps, and non-monster cards are not affected.
STAT_FILTER_DEF_MIN:
Minimum DEF

Only show YgoDuelist monsters whose printed DEF is at least this value. Leave empty for no lower bound. Spells, traps, and non-monster cards are not affected.
STAT_FILTER_DEF_MAX:
Maximum DEF

Only show YgoDuelist monsters whose printed DEF is at most this value. Leave empty for no upper bound. Spells, traps, and non-monster cards are not affected.
